# Halbert Feature Reference

> The reference details page for Halbert: all 44 features, how each works, which files implement it, and its safety boundaries. Companion to the main site at https://halbert.computer/ — the mind in your computer and the smart in your home, documented end to end.

Halbert is an embodied host epistemology and cognition layer that bridges system administration and Home Assistant automation into one private runtime: proactive system triage, physical room automation, and native Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools over a 100% local architecture with zero telemetry.

## Feature Catalog (44 features, 8 categories)

### Picks the Right Brain for the Job

- **Right-Sized Intelligence**: Automatically routes simple queries to fast local models and reserves deep reasoning for complex system diffs.
- **Air-Gapped Private Execution**: Sensitive credentials and system configs never egress to cloud APIs. Fail-closed, not fail-open.
- **Hot-Swap Any Provider**: Switch between Ollama, LM Studio, Apple Foundation Models, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Azure without restarting.
- **Context Window Compression**: Level-of-Detail memory management keeping long conversations from blowing the context ceiling.
- **Structured Agent Lifecycle**: Every turn moves through formal states with strict tool-call budgets and CRAG verification.
- **Secure Credential Storage**: Encrypted vault for API keys and provider secrets — never stored in plaintext config files.

### Knows What's Wrong Before You Do

- **37 Pluggable System Scanners**: Live probing across Linux and macOS: disks, SMART, thermal, USB, network, services, packages, wifi, boot, display, containers, processes, and more.
- **GPU & AI Accelerator Diagnostics**: Dedicated hardware inspection for GPUs (NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, Apple Metal) and AI accelerators (Coral TPU, Hailo, MemryX, NPUs).
- **The Four Whys**: Every finding explains why now, why care, why so, and why trust — with real detector evidence, not raw error dumps.
- **Calm Notification Attunement** (unlisted in the UI): Push (voice, auto-open panels), Ambient (badges, tray indicator), Pull (findings page, timeline) — three attention tiers.
- **Autonomous Self-Management Cycles**: 5-phase background loops (Sense → Deliberate → Propose → Act → Reflect) driving autonomous issue resolution.
- **Proactive Morning Reports & Reflexes**: Autonomous daily briefing and reflexive responses to significant events without waiting for user prompting.
- **Full Computer Vision Suite**: Screen capture (Wayland-aware), ambient webcam monitoring, OCR text extraction, and motion detection.
- **Apps & Container Management**: Docker, Podman, Flatpak, Snap, and AppImage lifecycle management with a dedicated dashboard panel.

### Safe Surgery on System Files

- **Blast Radius Before You Edit**: Config dependency graph showing exactly which services break if you change a file, before you touch it.
- **AI Diff Proposals with Instant Rollback**: SEARCH/REPLACE proposals rendered as visual diffs in Monaco, with mandatory pre-save snapshots and one-click restore.
- **Intent Kept Next to the Change**: The "Why Brain" captures the human rationale alongside config changes and restores it into future conversation context.
- **Cross-Session Memory Vault**: Threads, receipts, and machine-state history survive reboots without polluting active prompts with stale context.
- **Change Provenance Tracking**: Who changed a file, when, and why — linked to the state ledger with actor, reason, and content digest.
- **Human-in-the-Loop Approval Queue**: Mandatory user authorization gate for state-mutating actions with a dedicated dashboard page.
- **Pre-Execution Dry-Run Simulation** (unlisted in the UI): Simulates file writes, service restarts, and tool calls before touching disk — preview the impact without the risk.

### Answers Grounded in Real Documentation

- **Offline Hybrid Retrieval**: Sparse BM25 keyword matching merged with dense semantic embeddings via Reciprocal Rank Fusion — no cloud search needed.
- **Thousands of Indexed Documents**: Man pages, Arch Wiki, FreeBSD Handbook, Homebrew, and TLDR pages — all indexed locally.
- **Cite-and-Verify Links**: Every suggested command cites the local on-disk manual page — no hallucinated flags.
- **Web Search Fallback**: When local knowledge is insufficient, the agent can search the web — off by default, explicit opt-in.

### A Workspace, Not Another Chat Window

- **Unified Three-Panel Shell**: System domain rail, context stage, and agent conversation visible simultaneously — no modal context-switching.
- **Inline Terminal Tiles with Sandbox**: Commands the agent runs stream live stdout/stderr directly inside chat turns, with sandbox isolation and redact filters.
- **Direct @Mentions for Hardware & Services**: Reference a live disk, service, or network interface directly in chat — the agent gets the full discovery context.
- **Keyboard-First Command Palette**: Press / to open instant fuzzy search across every feature, domain, and setting.
- **Shell Integration**: Injects Halbert helpers into .bashrc and .zshrc so the agent is available from any terminal session.
- **Dynamic Skill Registry**: Agent loads and composes skill extensions at runtime — new capabilities without redeployment.
- **Olivetti Design Language**: Vermilion & Bone tokens, display serif typography, and a calm editorial aesthetic across the entire system.

### Speaks and Listens Without the Cloud

- **Instant Local Voice Pipeline**: On-device streaming ASR and TTS with sub-second latency, wake-word detection, barge-in, and speaker identification.
- **Acoustic Environment Sensing**: Ambient sound monitoring that detects anomalies: fan bearing failures, alarms, sudden noise spikes.
- **Screenshot & Diagram Analysis**: Paste, drag, or capture an image for the vision model to analyze and explain — Wayland-aware screen capture included.
- **Visual Aura State Indicator**: A non-intrusive ambient pulse reflecting voice pipeline state: idle, listening, thinking, speaking.

### One Mind Across Every Machine

- **Zero-Friction Peer Pairing**: Secure 4-digit PIN handshake over mDNS or direct IP, with per-peer tokens and surgical revocation.
- **Canonical Host + Satellite Bodies**: One primary memory store; satellite machines proxy tool execution and local sensors. Shared context, distributed hardware.
- **Remote Tool Execution Proxy**: Run tools on a peer machine from the primary dashboard — results return through the authenticated channel.
- **Built-in MCP Server**: Halbert exposes its own tools and resources for external agents to consume via the Model Context Protocol.

### A Home That Pays Attention

- **Home Assistant Entity Control**: Lights, climate, sensors, switches — direct local API integration, no vendor cloud, no subscription.
- **Autonomous Cognitive Loop** (deferred): Perceive → Reason → Act → Observe → Reflect — runs on a configurable timer, only invokes the LLM when something novel happens.
- **Occupancy & Behavior Learning**: Multi-signal presence correlation and pattern prediction — learns routines without explicit schedules.
- **Frigate NVR Event Ingestion**: Local object-detection events and snapshots from cameras, no cloud streaming.

## Supported Platforms

- Linux (Ubuntu, Debian, Fedora, Arch)
- macOS (Apple Silicon; Intel supported via local runtimes)
- Home Assistant (peer node)
